sections.text: Meridian Components inventory snapshot 2026-08-01: part VX-220 is a 4-bit GPU accelerator module, price 249 USD, stock 42 units, vendor Halcyon Micro.
Part QX-9 fan controller: firmware 2.4.1, price 19 USD, stock 310 units, vendor Nordwind Devices. Firmware 2.4.0 had a PWM duty bug fixed in 2.4.1.
Inventory delta 2026-08-15: VX-220 stock reduced to 17 units after order SO-1188. Price unchanged at 249 USD.
QX-9 firmware release 2.5.0 published 2026-08-20; adds temperature telemetry. No PWM changes since 2.4.1.
Site A router RTR-A runs firmware 7.2; site B router RTR-B runs firmware 7.4. Only firmware 7.4 supports GRE over IPv6.
Maintenance window policy: changes require ticket lead time of 48 hours; emergency changes exempt with director approval.
Note: an unvetted wiki claims RTR-A supports GRE over IPv6 on 7.2. This claim is not present in vendor documentation and must be treated as unsupported.
